name: Daisanji Supe* Robo Daisakusen! ~Kannai Ryoujoku Shinsatsu~
original_name: 第3次スパ○ボ大作戦! ～艦内療辱診察～
source:
This time's main character, an enemy spy, appears as a cool as a cucumber, cold hearted doctor.

He enters the battle ship under the guise of being their medical physician.
Secretly he targets "Ku*uha, Ze*la, and La*uni" the three super skilled pilots!

Finally he has carefully completed all the preliminary details of his plan. All thats left is for the events to go into motion!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ041380.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
本次的主人公是一名敌方间谍，外表是一位沉着冷静、内心冷酷的医生。

他以随舰医生的身份，潜入战舰。
暗地里，他盯上了楠叶、泽奥拉与拉托妮这三位技术高超的驾驶员！

如今，计划的前期准备已被他细心完成，剩下的，就只等一切开始运转！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ041380.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
